name: plain-xstate
title: Launch blurb writer (plain XState)

origin.source: New example for driving a library-unaware XState v6 machine

comparison.purpose: Writes and revises a product launch blurb using an ordinary XState machine that knows nothing about the agent library — the runtime picks the next event from the ones the machine accepts.

starters: a CLI that turns shell history into a changelog
